body.div:
graph TB subgraph "Developer Workstation (Local)" Git["Git Repository
Code + Config"] Env1[".env File
Local secrets"] DC["docker compose up
(from Compose file)"] end
subgraph "Docker Compose Orchestration (Local / VM)" Network["Docker Network
glassmate"]
subgraph "Backend Container" PyImage["Image: python:3.12-slim"] App["FastAPI App
app.main:app"] Uvicorn["uvicorn
0.0.0.0:8000"] HealthBE["Health Check
GET /health"] end
subgraph "Frontend Container" NodeImage["Image: node:24-alpine
Multi-stage Build"] ViteB["Vite Build
(npm run build)"] Serve["serve
-l 3000"] HealthFE["Health Check
GET / 200"] end
subgraph "Database Container" PgImage["Image: postgres:16-alpine"] PgPort["Port 5432
(internal)"] PgVolume["Volume:
glassmate_postgres_data"] HealthDB["Health Check
pg_isready"] end end
subgraph "Environment Configuration" Vars["DATABASE_URL
POSTGRES_USER/PASSWORD/DB
VITE_API_URL
ENVIRONMENT
LOG_LEVEL
NODE_ENV"] end
subgraph "External Services (Optional)" GitHub1["GitHub API
Public Repos"] Gmail1["Gmail API
OAuth Setup"] Calendar1["Google Calendar
OAuth Setup"] end
subgraph "CI/CD Pipeline (GitHub Actions)" CI["Trigger: push to main
or PR"] BackendTest["Backend Job:
pytest -v
PostgreSQL:16-alpine"] FrontendBuild["Frontend Job:
npm ci
npm run build"] Results["Results: Pass/Fail
Commit Status"] end
Git --> DC Env1 --> DC DC --> Network
Network --> PyImage Network --> NodeImage Network --> PgImage
PyImage --> App --> Uvicorn --> HealthBE NodeImage --> ViteB --> Serve --> HealthFE PgImage --> PgPort PgPort --> PgVolume PgImage --> HealthDB
App -.-> PgPort Uvicorn -.-> HealthDB Serve -.-> Uvicorn
Vars -.-> App Vars -.-> Uvicorn Vars -.-> ViteB Vars -.-> Serve
App -.-> GitHub1 App -.-> Gmail1 App -.-> Calendar1
Git --> CI CI --> BackendTest CI --> FrontendBuild BackendTest --> Results FrontendBuild --> Results
